scope: Read-only native material/coarse-geometry responsibility review; no product changes or geometry recommendation accepted by this report.

postDiffusion.evidence: One native scene/camera render, two draw calls; no separable diffusion or quad compose passes. Expanded fragment has one psDirect wrapper calling RE_Direct_Physical once. Existing multi-pass faceDiffusion code is present in source but not active in the recorded baseline frame.

rgbLightWrap.limitations: These bounds describe the positive-NdotL directional-light branch at pcBlend<=1. RectArea uses a separate physical path. This is not a measured per-pixel contribution distribution or volume SSS.

coarseGeometry.wrapper: Only while mother.update runs: anatomy.settings.microGeometry = original * .35; restore original in finally.
coarseGeometry.hw: Bilinear sample of red channel by default; (byte-128)/255*.00025 metres. Green is not sampled by this geometry path.
coarseGeometry.envelopeCaveat: Atlas sample envelope only. Actual vertices depend on bilinear locations, red/inner masks and strain. Not an actual displaced-vertex extremum. stats.minHeightMM sums R+G and must not be quoted as red geometry depth.
coarseGeometry.primaryCrossSection: amplitude*sin(pi*along)^.58*(-exp(-1.7*(distance/width)^2)+.105*exp(-.22*(distance/width)^2)); negative overlaps use min, positive rims use max only where not already negative.
coarseGeometry.missingScaleInference: Native so-called coarse relief and R01 fine field mostly encode narrow negative line grooves with overlapping horizontal width ranges. Neither supplies broad two-dimensional tissue facets between grooves. Scaling coarse .35 back up changes depth, not field coverage or width.

additiveLargeShape.interpretation: A broad extra native lip roll is added to the original person; .35 coarse scale leaves it unchanged. Changing lowerVolume changes original character lip thickness and is NOT accepted as a texture fix.

ablationOnly.execution: If ever needed, restore a copied complete native archive with this single field changed so R05/R06 calibration is rebuilt by its supported restore chain. Do not hide changed parameters from sourceKey validation.
ablationOnly.rejectIf: Only thinner lips, without improved material organization; any unwanted character change.

microSelfOcclusion.model: Isolated negative Gaussian with peak depth A, filtered width W: tan(horizon from valley bottom)≈.63817*A/W. Uniform all-azimuth horizon loss sin(theta)^2 is an upper surrogate, not the finite groove actual AO.
microSelfOcclusion.limitations: Isolated field model, not actual full-field shadow tracing. Local intersections, native folds and endpoint geometry can differ. Current evidence does not justify painting strong AO dark lines.

newExperimentsConclusions.restCentralDifference: Actual root/independent image review found more continuous lines, still only local small benefit; not a wax fix.
newExperimentsConclusions.positiveShoulders: Root actual review: large smooth pink volume persists with fine marks; rejected as overall quality improvement.
newExperimentsConclusions.specularOff: Root actual review: reflection weakens but smooth volume remains; matte is not more real.
newExperimentsConclusions.continuousMeso25MicronCoefficient: Root actual review: small particle effect, max pixel delta 6DN; not accepted.
newExperimentsConclusions.mesoFilteringCaveat: 1.7/3.2 value noise means .588/.3125mm lattice; about5.0/2.7 pixels at baseline median footprint. The coefficient25um multiplies[-.5,.5]; gain.55*visibility.879 yields±6.04um before other envelopes. No independent analytical footprint low-pass was added; main Gaussian w/W does not filter the new noise.

decision: Final candidate selected by root is only original R03-organized-main4 fragment replacement with inherited screen derivatives. No derivative correction, shoulders, meso, colour/edge change, specular removal or geometry changes. Limited local benefit; overall wax-like appearance unresolved.

subsequentIndependentMesoReview.weak25: Blind reviewer gives a weak local positive signal, no necessity to replace baseline and no stable advantage over A/H; not selected.
subsequentIndependentMesoReview.strong100: Root and blind reviewer reject dense granular/embossed surface despite less smoothness.
subsequentIndependentMesoReview.amplitudes: Nominal height coefficients, not measured tissue depths.
